scenarios.name: colorless-spell-cast-for-zero
scenarios.why: Darksteel Monolith lets its controller pay {0} instead of a colorless spell's mana cost once each turn, so with an empty pool Cathodion (colorless) is cast for free.

scenarios.name: once-each-turn-second-colorless-pays
scenarios.why: The {0} alternative is once each turn: after the first colorless spell is cast for free, the second cannot use it, so with an empty pool it is not offered.

scenarios.name: colored-spell-not-free
scenarios.why: The {0} alternative applies only to colorless spells; Grizzly Bears is green, so with an empty pool it is not offered.

scenarios.name: without-monolith-colorless-not-free
scenarios.why: Without Darksteel Monolith there is no {0} alternative, so with an empty pool the colorless spell is not offered.
